front.title: XCIM: Verifiable Communication Authorization for Direct Email

abstract.t: XCIM specifies experimental evidence linking purpose-specific communication authorization to an application, an original email recipient, and message content. A signed receipt records an issuer's observation of consent; a receiver also verifies current permission, signing authority, freshness, authenticated publication, and DKIM. The minimum direct-email profile uses one recipient and purpose per message copy, issuer-signed recipient binding, and application- authorized message signatures. This document defines a bounded experimental integration and identifies unresolved lifecycle, history-continuity, and registration questions. It does not establish the truth of an issuer's consent observation or claim production readiness.
